text: {"name":"ke_send_driver_start_stop_msg","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Builds and submits message 0x7C with vendor information and a cached radio-mode flag while updating state for a driver start or stop.","subsystem":"ke","var_renames":{"a2":"start_stop_config","a1a":"rom_vendor_info","v5":"message_payload","v6":"vendor_info","v7":"radio_state","v8":"sw_enable","v9":"is_5ghz"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Input config byte: nonzero selects driver start; zero selects stop."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Input config byte: nonzero selects ROM-derived vendor information."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Fallback vendor-information byte when config byte 1 is zero."},{"offset":3,"meaning":"Optional start-only flag that sets bit 14 in the global flags word."},{"offset":178,"meaning":"Global 16-bit flags word; bit 14 is set by the optional start-only flag."},{"offset":188,"meaning":"Cached 5-GHz/radio-mode flag, populated from vendor-information bit 5."}]}
